profile.headline: Principal Software Engineer IV at Concur
profile.summary:
I'm passionate about keeping up with technology innovations and the really interesting problems of scaling solutions. I started as a generalist web application developer, working on all areas of web application development in multiple platforms, from SQL query tuning to javascript to server setup. Now I'm working on developer tools, frameworks, DevOps challenges, and internal platforms.  

I'm the area principal for our travel monolith services. I'm also working on a kotlin microservice for payment rules for customers to manage allowed forms of payment in different travel scenarios.

http://stackoverflow.com/users/1695398/brian-white

Strengths: C#, SQL Server, ASP.Net, New Relic, git, nuget, choco, IIS, encryption

Technologies used currently: Nuget, Chocolatey, Jenkins, Couchbase, Redis, Memcached, RabbitMQ, JSON, MSSql, ElasticSearch, Kibana, New Relic, Hashicorp Vault, CloudFormation/AWS, kotlin, spring-boot, Drools

Older skills: Perl, Tcl, Vignette, VB, Sybase, prototype javascript framework, classic asp, Application Dynamics, postgresql, Oracle 

Core travel at Concur covers scale, hosting, shared libraries for security, database access, logging, and configuration. We also support several roletypes we deploy in production.

positions.title: Principal Engineer III
positions.description: Area principal for travel monolith, working on adding net new features, dealing with scaling problems, keeping dependencies updated, ensuring security.

positions.title: Principal Software Engineer II
positions.description:
I'm currently working on:
* Fedramp compliance and FIPS
* Migration from Colo to AWS
* Delivering libraries as NuGet packages
* DevOps ownership of services
* Core dotnet library updates - encryption, logging, caching
* t2 payment rules in kotlin

positions.title: Principal Software Engineer I
positions.description:
I returned to an individual contributor role after an org unit change that moved my team back into the travel team and out of the central architecture team. I'm happiest working with curly braces regularly :)

* Led the effort to add code support for read replicas in Sql Server 2012. For this project we avoided changing any function signatures in the database library layer and added smarts to the library, using a control table to redirect specific queries to the read replica.
* Worked on a new sharding strategy for a PostgreSql system to ensure high availability for writes and easy horizontal scalability.
* Working on projects to move parts of our largest database into other datastores and to encapsulate them in micro-services.

positions.title: Development Manager - Core Architecture
positions.description:
*Supported moving Concur from a single datacenter to multi-datacenter with European datacenter rollout.
*Supported Concur's government offering rolling out a .net midtier for it and updating our database libraries to be able to query Progress OpenEdge over ODBC
*Led a distributed team working on adding capabilities into our core libraries: adding support for postgresql, in house pseudo-sharding for RDBMSes, updates to Couchbase and RabbitMQ libraries, updates to logging libraries to integrate with new logging service

positions.title: Software Engineer through Principal 1
positions.description:
* I started at a smaller (75-ish people) company named Outtask which was acquired by Concur.  Originally I worked on Outtask's expense offering.  After the acquisition I moved to work on Concur's meeting offering, then onto e-receipts, then onto a travel infrastructure team.  
* Front end coding in ASP, ASP.NET MVC, prototype, jQuery, plain javascript.  
* Back end coding in C# executables, webservices, WSF
* Replaced credit card Blowfish encryption with AES 256
* Worked on integrating new project Itinerary Service project in Concur Travel to enable GDS-less trips to be booked in Cliqbook.  
* E-receipt project which crossed travel, expense, and imaging teams.  Worked closely with external providers and production monitoring for partner onboarding.  E-receipts enable Concur's Smart Expense matching system to prepare expense reports with almost no work for travelers.
* Fixed database performance issues in prod
* Updated database libraries to handle new versions of Sql Server.
* Created new databases
* Integrated new database technologies
* Lead developer training sessions on various topics: SQL server 2008 features, XML in SQL, data extraction from in house sharded database, unit testing frameworks
* Maintained the stock developer VM to add new parts of the Concur stack and upgrade technologies.
* Locate & Alert- used Bing Maps and database side pin clustering.

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description: * ASP/HTML/Javascript/Oracle development. Query development against Oracle.  We created a critical online tool for the Centers for Medicare and Medicaid Services to review bids submitted by health plans to provide services under the new prescription drug benefit in Medicare Part D.

positions.title: Web Application Developer
positions.description:
* Rewrote main online diet plan application.  Rewrote main recipe search.  Replaced site forum.
* Content export to partners: RecipeML, DocBook, custom formats.
* Created site search for non-database static content using Microsoft Index Server.
* Added 3rd party tool to monitor mail bouncebacks and manage mailing lists
* Responsibilities: Complete database design and development, maintenance and support duties for databases, web servers, and all machines on our LAN.  Custom web applications, 3rd party product integration, newsletter management. Local network administration, Exchange admin, Symantec administrator, firewall management.

positions.title: Web/Database Developer
positions.description:
* Converted Media Watch application from Lotus Notes to Microsoft stack: VB data entry client, SQL Server, ASP site.  Media Watch is used by the Secretary of State.
* Internal project tracking database for the Office of Broadcast Services in the Department of State’s Public Affairs Bureau.  
* Requirements gathering from stakeholders, design, development, deployment, project manager duties.

company.name: MainStreet Technologies Inc on contract at Department of State

positions.title: Web Application Developer
positions.description: * E-commerce integration/recurring subscriptions, ASP/HTML/Javascript, database development, encryption.

positions.title: Web Developer
positions.description:
* Customer care application in ASP/COM, Windows 3-tier design, XML/DOM/DHTML.  
* Database design in Sybase.  
* Multiple shopping cart projects using Vignette StoryServer/Tcl on Unix.
* CMS development to manage site content
* Affiliate network integration, branding, reporting
* Custom VB app using the IE web browser component, integrated with Sybase and Access databases using RDO and DAO.  
* Back-end jobs using Perl scripts, cron jobs, FTP.
